anomalies.description: A man seated in a utility vehicle fires a mounted automatic weapon, producing sustained muzzle flash, smoke, and visible recoil; the target area (trees) shows progressive impact effects including dust/debris clouds and eventual tree damage.

A sudden localized blast occurs in the target zone (mid-right), evidenced by a rapid expansion of smoke/dust and visible displacement of foliage/branches, coinciding with continued firing; consistent with a high-velocity projectile impact on a hard object or explosive round detonation.

A controlled or accidental explosion occurs at the base of a tree, initiating with smoke and flash at 32.0s, rapidly escalating to a large fireball and debris ejection by 35.5s, and continuing through violent fragmentation and dust cloud expansion until 39.5s.
A violent detonation occurs at the base of a tree, generating a rapidly expanding fireball and dense smoke cloud, consistent with an explosive impact or secondary detonation.

A man seated in a utility vehicle fires a mounted automatic weapon repeatedly, producing visible muzzle flash and smoke plume that expands across the field.; The firing ceases; the man begins to stand up while the smoke from the last burst is still visible and dissipating.
A man fires a mounted automatic weapon repeatedly, producing visible muzzle flash, recoil, and a large cloud of smoke that expands across the field toward the targets.

A person seated in a utility vehicle is actively firing a mounted weapon (appears to be a machine gun or automatic firearm) toward a distant target, producing visible muzzle flashes and smoke plumes across multiple frames.

A sustained bright orange/red fireball and expanding smoke cloud appear in the distance, consistent with an explosion or incendiary impact triggered by the gunfire; the fireball persists and fluctuates in intensity over several seconds.
